verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software platform or API product, so a developer sandbox environment is a category error for this kind of product. Its client tools (trademark extranet, AI brief and contract review, dashboards, Fenwick Labs web services) are never described as offering a sandbox or test environment, so the exception for actually shipping the capability does not apply. The probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, which is consistent with having no developer-facing surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
